negative_reviews.author: Mara Basso
negative_reviews.text:
We had lunch today, booked in advance but we had to queue outside. We were in 2 but were served 10/15mins apart, no drinks were served until we reminded about them. Food was tasty and nice but lukewarm, dessert (creme brulee) was lovely. At some point after lunch we were asked to leave as the table was booked,  which is fine but why not offering us to move to a non-booked table given that the majority were empty?! Maybe short of staff but no apologies offered.
Will not book again.

negative_reviews.author: Marco Sun
negative_reviews.text:
Went there with my friends while I ordered a black garlic Ramen with ex. Noodles and cha siu.

Had to wait double the waiting time what my friends had, gave me the wrong food the first time, and when they got it right, the cha siu is warm at best. The bamboo is too salty as well.

At least the vibes are good. And I got 1 more cha siu for the wait. But the quality doesn't help.

For the 21 quid I spent this only worth 1 star.
